title: Concept: Lockfile integrity field present but empty
description: package-lock.json declares an integrity field that is present but empty, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An empty field reads as verified to every tool that only checks for the key, while nothing is actually verified at install time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: An empty field reads as verified to every tool that only checks for the key, while nothing is actually verified at install time.
